Collision |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]2 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.8 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]18 |pvp_speed = 4 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Pistol Goon''', also referred to as '''Pistol Crook''', is a unit that can be spawned from the [[Crook Boss]] from Level 0. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it and all other detectable enemies in its range. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. It has a 45 second spawnrate. It also spawns twice instead of once at Level 2+. There is a limit of 10 '''Pistol Goons''' per [[Crook Boss]]. ==Appearance== The '''Pistol Goon''' has tan skin. It wears a grey shirt, black shoes and vest with golden buttons, brown pants with a black belt and golden buckle, blue belt, white wrapping on left hand and grey opaque/translucent shades. [[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|Merch Shop]]Obtained by purchasing the [[Narrator Plush]]. |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *As it spawns from the Level 0 [[Crook Boss]], the '''Pistol Goon''' can be useful early on against weaker enemies like the [[Abnormal]] or [[Heavy]]. *The '''Pistol Goon''' deals full collision damage to enemies with defense, such as the [[Hefty]] or [[Heavy]]. **As it has low damage, it is also unlikely that its damage will be reduced as an enemy needs at least 50% defense to reduce it. *On maps with multiple paths, only one/two '''Pistol Goons''' spawn per [[Crook Boss]]. **Each '''Pistol Goon''' will go down a random path. *The '''Pistol Goon''' is unaffected by buffs and debuffs. *The '''Pistol Goon''' will struggle against enemies with abilities that deal damage to units because of its low health. **For example, the [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] will quickly kill the '''Pistol Goon''' if its caught in its laser. ==Trivia== *This is the third unit alongside the [[Golden Pistol Goon]] to spawn twice at a time, the first being the [[Cannoneer Elf]] and [[Gunner Elf]]. *The '''Pistol Goon''', alongside [[Golden Pistol Goon]], was the first unit to be able to detect flying enemies. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 February 2024''' -
